entries.title: Zephaniah 2:1
segments:
Gather yourselves; for confession and supplication.  The Jews are solemnly exhorted to repentance before the threatened evils come upon them. 
 
  Not desired; or, as some render, "without shame." 
 
vv 1-3. 
 
God graciously delays his threatened judgments, that we may have opportunity to escape them by repentance; but if we despise his long-suffering kindness, the day of mercy will soon pass away, and escape will be no longer possible.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:2
segments:
The decree; God's decree to make the land desolate. 
 
  Bring forth; go into effect; produce its progeny of misery. 
 
  Before the day pass as the chaff; before the day of God's forbearance pass quickly away.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:4
segments:
For Gaza shall be--a desolation; the devastation shall be universal, including all the nations bordering on Judea.  The four towns mentioned here were the four chief cities of the Philistines. Gath, the fifth, seems to have previously perished. 
 
vv 4-11. 
 
When God afflicts his people, he intends not their destruction, but their correction; he will not allow their enemies, who exult over their calamities, and take advantage of them to oppress and spoil them, to go unpunished; his own servants he will restore to more than their former prosperity, while those who hated and persecuted them perish without remedy.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:5
segments: The Cherethites; the same as Cherethim,

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:6
segments: Cottages for shepherds--folds for flocks; uncultivated pasture-ground.

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:7
segments: The coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; that is, the coast of the Philistines after its desolation.  God shall reinstate his people in their ancient possessions, and they shall be victorious over all their enemies, of whom the Philistines, Moabites, and Ammorites were among the most bitter and formidable.  Compare

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:12
segments: Ethiopians; these, in connection with Egypt, were at that time the rivals of Assyria,

entries.title: Zephaniah 2:13
segments: Will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness; the prophet foretells the utter desolation of Nineveh in language agreeing closely with that of Isaiah in reference to Babylon and Edom.  Compare
.  The present ruins of this renowned city are the best comment on his words.
